cards.coding_instructions:
One leaf outcome: Bind each adopted or explicitly retained-by-decision slice to accepted prerequisites, exact Git revision/source hashes, dependency decision and review evidence.
Before editing: verify pinned base 2b7cfb52024be0453e3b9333aba292b2372e610e, prerequisites and exclusive file leases. Write and run the independent failing contract first; save the command, exit code and immutable RED log.
Independent oracle: Actual accepted implementation/decision receipts; reject baseline-only checks and invalidate evidence whenever included source/dependency hashes change.
Implementation boundaries: Use standard Rust or the approved library API directly; keep only the domain-specific adapter. Do not build another generic compatibility framework.
Use named Rust structs/enums/newtypes and explicit Result errors at boundaries. Preserve unknown-field/variant policy, lossless identifiers, permissions, cancellation and resource ownership. English Rustdoc/comments explain invariants and why.
Targeted verification: Validate manifest hashes at native job start/end and reject any mismatch or missing included slice.
Attach positive, negative, boundary, error, empty, loading, capability/permission, recovery and telemetry cases where applicable; document a reason for each non-applicable dimension. Never weaken the existing assertions, retries, skips or timeouts.
Obsolete code removal criterion: Remove superseded hand-written infrastructure only after all consumers and independent parity tests pass. Moving code to another file or generated output is not a measured deletion.
Report net first-party hand-written production code, generated output, tests and dependencies separately; report startup/RSS/latency/binary/asset impact, and provide a rollback condition. Security/parity improvements may justify a temporary LOC increase only with explicit review.
Do not edit shared Cargo/package locks, registry exports, app.js/main.rs integration points, board/journal or golden evidence outside your explicit lease. Coordinator owns shared integration. No direct shared-branch push, live account actions or self-approval.

cards.estimated_scope: One outcome, one feature/API boundary; split again if the exact lease exceeds one small reviewable PR.
cards.definition_of_ready: Accepted prerequisite artifacts, independent oracle, approved dependency decision and exclusive leases; ready is not equivalent to launched.
cards.rollback: Revert this isolated slice or keep the previous adapter selected; never dual-execute side effects or downgrade secret storage.

integration_subtasks.instruction: Compile the actual transitional Tauri binary for six native OS/architecture targets, retain source/lock/artifact provenance and complete artifacts. Treat source checks, compiler metadata and native runtime qualification separately.

Operator-directed native compile repairs: preserve canonical checkout source/lock bytes and caller-relative120ms coalescing, retain original assertions and native failures, then verify the exact candidate on all six native runners. Parent acceptance remains open.

runtime_resolution.policy: Resolve future effort/model from complexity and actual supported profiles; never silently use the unavailable Gemini alias.
